info.description: Approval workflow requests for credential issuance. A requester submits, an issuer approves or rejects.

achievementId.description: Numeric ID of the achievement to issue

requesterNote.description: Optional note from the person requesting the credential

reviewerNote.description: Note from the reviewer when approving or rejecting

submittedByEmail.description: Email of the user who submitted the request

reviewedByEmail.description: Email of the issuer who reviewed the request

issuedCredentialId.description: credentialId (URN) of the issued credential once approved
